title: Momentum Deck Kits and Runner Templates (Lite → Enterprise)
slides: Slide 1 — Opening: 'Momentum snapshot' — 90s: quick win bullets, 30s ask (decision owner). Speaker note: set expectations — refresh agenda, highlight renewal target and decision owner.

Slide 2 — Health topline: usage + adoption + uptime. Visual: three metrics band (DAU, feature adoption %, avg latency). Speaker note: focus on trends not absolute numbers; call out 1–2 anomalies with root-cause pointers.
Slide 3 — Outcomes delivered: customer stories + before/after metrics. Format: 2 micro-case studies (title, objective, metric delta, quote). Speaker note: keep to impact > features.
Slide 4 — Cost / ROI snapshot: month-to-month TCO delta and projected 12-month ROI. Include simple waterfall: platform cost vs business value. Speaker note: tie to renewal ask (pricing anchor).
Slide 5 — Risk & blockers: active open items that could affect renewal. Use RAG status and owner. Speaker note: propose mitigation / timeline for each.
Slide 6 — Roadmap alignment: next 90 days prioritized features tied to customer outcomes. Format: 3 lanes (product, services, integrations). Speaker note: confirm prioritization and gating criteria.
Slide 7 — Renewal options: Lite (self-serve), Standard, Enterprise. Table with capex/commitments/SLAs. Speaker note: highlight recommended option based on observed usage and risk tolerance.
Slide 8 — Commercials and timeline: proposed contract length, pricing bands, pilot-to-production milestones. Speaker note: be transparent on negotiation band and escalation path.
Slide 9 — Implementation plan & owner map: week-by-week summary for next 90 days plus named contacts for each milestone. Speaker note: confirm mutual owners and decision checkpoints.
Slide 10 — Renewal momentum scorecard: live score and top 3 playbook moves. Speaker note: call for alignment on top 3 actions and who will execute.
Slide 11 — Ask & next steps: specific asks (sign PO, authorize pilot extension, approve SOW). Speaker note: end with a single clear decision and date for follow-up.
Slide 12 — Appendix: data sources, deep-dive dashboards, FAQs, legal terms. Speaker note: use appendix to absorb nitty-gritty questions so main meeting stays executive-focused.
renewal_momentum_rubric: 80–100 (Green): Strong usage + exec sponsor engaged + no major blockers — prepare standard renewal package and ask for 60-day signature.
50–79 (Yellow): Moderate signals (feature adoption but exec not engaged or 1 blocker) — run targeted play (enablement + exec touchpoint) and 30–60 day cadence.
0–49 (Red): Low usage, product blockers, or exec churn risk — escalate to CSM manager and solutions engineer, propose a remediation SOW before renewal conversation.
Scoring inputs: product usage trend (40%), executive engagement (25%), outstanding technical blockers (20%), payment/legal friction (15%).
action_playbook: Activate 'Momentum Runner' (6-week play) — weekly touchpoints, prioritized success milestones, 2 exec check-ins. Owner: CSM.
Deploy 'Nudge Runner' (light touch, for 30–60 day low-risk renewals) — deliver ROI one-pager, invite to product roadmap call. Owner: AE + CSM.
Escalation path for High Risk — schedule internal warroom with Solutions, Engineering, and Sales leadership; propose remediation SOW within 10 business days.
Commercial levers: limited-time credit, usage-based true-up clause, or staged commitment (pilot→commit). Use only after commercial/CS alignment.
Exec rehearsal checklist: 1) Confirm outcome metric, 2) Align on ask, 3) Rehearse answers to top 3 objections, 4) Confirm mutual next step and date.
sample_outreach_email:
Subject: Quick prep for our upcoming QBR — one ask

Hi [Customer Exec Name],

Looking forward to our QBR on [date]. Short agenda: 1) Results & impact, 2) Roadmap alignment, 3) Renewal options.

Could you please confirm: the primary decision owner for renewal and any key dates we should align to? Also attaching a 1‑page ROI snapshot we will review.

If you prefer, we can run a 20‑minute pre-brief with you and the procurement lead before the QBR.

Thanks,
[CSM name] — Redwood Inference

example_account_play: Example: Acme Retail (ARR $240k, renewal in 78 days, momentum 62). Recommended runner: Momentum Runner + 2-week exec nudge. Open blockers: late integration on SSO; owner: solutions-engineering. Next milestone: SSO remediation demo on MM/DD.
